d.t: SPACER TAB FOR PEDESTAL SYSTEM FOR RAISED TIMBER TILE FLOORING
d.s: SikaRoof VersiJack Timber Tile Fastener is an accessory used on top of pedestals to secure timber tiles and create precise and uniform gaps for the alignment of timber tiles in raised flooring systems. Timber tile fasteners are manufactured from modified reinforced thermoplastics, and has a locking mechanism using a screw. SikaRoof VersiJack Timber Tile Fastener is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiJack and timber tiles, and it's locking mechanism locks into grooves on the sides of a timber tile.
a: Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Timber tile fasteners are used with adjustable pedestals for raised timber tile flooring on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
